job.title: Account Director | Contract
job.description:
Freelance Account Director | $500-550 inc | Sydney North
  
This independent agency is looking for an Account Director to help deliver 3 brand launch campaigns for a major Betting & Gaming client.  Large integrated campaign experience is mandatory as this campaign will launch across both traditional and on-line channels.
  
The contract will run until Christmas but has the potential to extend or even go permanent
  
You’ll work closely and be mentored by an experienced Client Service Director and will have ability to work with an internal production and content arm.

What's in it for you?
  • Work on brand launch campaigns with big media budgets
  • Be mentored by a CSD
  • Tight-knit team culture
  • Good transport links (Metro)
  • Hybrid working 4 days in the office and 1 day from home
What do you need? 
  • Local creative agency experience
  • Account Director level or beyond experience
  • Integrated experience including TVC, OOH, Digital, Social, and Content
  • Switched on, great under pressure, with a tonne of initiative
  • Team player
  • Immediately available

job.title: Content Producer
job.description:
A fantastic opportunity to join a fast-growing financial services brand on a growth trajectory. We are looking for a creative, hands-on Content Producer to help scale its organic social presence and paid advertising.

You’ll work directly alongside the founder to build a high-volume content engine across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Meta ads.

This is a hands-on production role, you’ll be behind the camera, developing creative concepts, testing new formats and helping build the systems required to produce content consistently at scale.

What You’ll Do
  • Plan and structure weekly content production, including preparation and shooting of materials
  • Shoot high-volume short-form organic content and paid ad creative
  • Produce long-form YouTube/podcast-style content and repurpose it across social platforms
  • Test different ad formats, hooks, angles and creative concepts
  • Work closely with the founder on creative direction and content strategy
  • Brief and direct an offshore editor to maintain quality and consistency
  • Learn and apply Meta Ads Manager to help optimise campaign performance
  • Help build a scalable content production system across various touch-points of the business
What We’re Looking For
  • 4–5 years’ experience creating content and recording ads, ideally for service-based businesses.
  • Strong camera and shooting skills with the ability to capture various formats
  • Good editing knowledge and an understanding of what makes content perform
  • Experience working with or directing editors when required
  • Comfortable producing high volumes of content and moving quickly
  • Creative, proactive and willing to test new ideas
  • Interested in learning the paid advertising side of the business, from in-platform planning and placement to campaign performance
  • A systems thinker who wants to build processes, not just execute individual shoots
  • Comfortable working closely with a founder in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
The long-term goal is to build an in-house media team. Strong performance across organic social and paid advertising will create an opportunity for this role to grow into a leadership position as the media function scales.

Location: Parramatta (Sydney) 
Type: Full-time, onsite (some flexibility may be agreed)
Salary: $100 - 120k + super

If you’re a content producer who loves being behind the camera, thrives on volume and wants to develop your skills across creative strategy and paid media, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now by submitting your CV online.
